exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.instructions: Start in a plank position with hands shoulder-width apart. Lower your body until your chest nearly touches the ground. Push back up to starting position.

exercises.name: Squats
exercises.instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Lower your body by bending knees and hips. Keep back straight and return to starting position.

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
exercises.instructions: Start standing with feet together and arms at sides. Jump feet apart while raising arms overhead, then return to starting position.

exercises.name: Arm Circles
exercises.instructions: Stand with arms extended to sides. Make circular motions with arms, gradually increasing circle size.

exercises.name: Dynamic Leg Swings
exercises.instructions: Stand on one leg, swing other leg forward and back in a controlled motion. Switch legs after set.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.instructions: Hold a push-up position with forearms on ground. Keep body straight from head to heels.

exercises.name: Side Plank Left
exercises.instructions: Lie on left side, prop up on left forearm. Raise hips until body forms straight line.

exercises.name: Side Plank Right
exercises.instructions: Lie on right side, prop up on right forearm. Raise hips until body forms straight line.

exercises.name: Lunges
exercises.instructions: Step forward with one leg, lowering hips until both knees are bent at 90 degrees. Return and alternate legs.

exercises.name: Leg Raises
exercises.instructions: Lie on back, legs straight. Keeping legs together, lift them up to 90 degrees, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: High Knees
exercises.instructions: Run in place, lifting knees as high as possible. Maintain quick pace.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Rows
exercises.instructions: Bend at hips, back straight. Pull dumbbells to sides of chest, then lower.

exercises.name: Torso Twists
exercises.instructions: Sit with knees bent, feet off ground. Rotate torso side to side, keeping core engaged.

exercises.name: Ankle Circles
exercises.instructions: Lift foot off ground, rotate ankle in circular motion. Switch directions and feet.

exercises.name: Wrist Circles
exercises.instructions: Extend arms, rotate wrists in circular motion. Switch directions.

exercises.name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
exercises.instructions: Stand straight, bend forward at hips, keeping legs straight. Reach for toes.

exercises.name: Calf Stretch
exercises.instructions: Stand facing wall, one leg forward bent, back leg straight. Lean forward, keeping back heel down.

exercises.name: Seated Forward Bend
exercises.instructions: Sit with legs extended. Bend forward from hips, reaching for toes.

exercises.name: Cobra Stretch
exercises.instructions: Lie face down, push chest up with arms while keeping hips on ground.

exercises.name: Child's Pose
exercises.instructions: Kneel on floor, sit back on heels. Extend arms forward, lowering chest to ground.

exercises.name: Neck Rolls
exercises.instructions: Slowly roll head in circular motion, keeping shoulders relaxed.

exercises.name: Shoulder Rolls
exercises.instructions: Roll shoulders forward in circular motion, then backward.
